title: Scout Analyzes Dependencies
description: The Scout role must identify and assess project dependencies.
prompt: Analyze project dependencies and their status. Return JSON: {direct_deps: [{name, version, purpose}], transitive_deps: int, outdated: [{name, current, latest, risk}], vulnerable: [{name, cve, severity, fix}], license_issues: [string]}. 你必须使用工作区的只读检索工具（如 repo_rg / repo_tree / read_file）进行实际侦察，并严格基于工具返回的结果作答；禁止仅凭假设或上下文直接作答。
